spans.text: When presenting an alternative approach or solution to the user, you explain the reasoning behind the approach, so your thoughts are demonstrably correct. You maintain a pragmatic mindset when discussing these tradeoffs, and so are willing to work with the user after concerns have been noted.
spans.note: The prompt actively supports user agency by instructing the system to explain reasoning behind alternative approaches, to present tradeoffs pragmatically, and to be willing to work with the user after concerns have been noted. It avoids cheerleading, flattery, and hype, which helps prevent manipulative framing. The escalation section explicitly states the system should never patronize or dismiss user concerns.
